plan.scope: post-review exploratory reused validation; no confirmatory inference
plan.strata: separate zero tumour area; quantile bins of positive area crossed with axial-index quantile bins
plan.bins_fit: fixed validation-covariate quantiles, no feature/label-purity optimization
plan.null_scope: descriptive conditional reference, not causal adjustment or patient-level permutation test; area uses annotation masks
plan.orientation: univariate AUROC orientation chosen on training tumour labels only; applied frozen to validation
plan.budgets: every integer J>=8 up to maximum eligible count; common paired domain plus method-specific endpoint
plan.missing_bounds: retain selected IDs; [0,1] for unscorable purity; do not replace or renormalize them in bounded mean
plan.random_rule: without replacement, nested random permutations of same selector candidate pool
plan.aggregation: average SAE seeds within encoder first; report 3 encoder means; feature-level p-values not interpreted
plan.supervised_scope: new native SAE fits on archived supervised encoder vectors, historical SAE initialization/optimizer recipe; encoder objective/augmentation differ
